volk meta-loader — vendored for VULKAN-VOLK-LOADER-1

Files: volk.h + volk.c (the complete volk distribution; volk is header + one .c).

VOLK_HEADER_VERSION: 343   (grep '#define VOLK_HEADER_VERSION' volk.h)

Source on disk (copied verbatim, no network fetch):
  C:/Users/Joe/AppData/Local/rdc/renderdoc-build/renderdoc/util/test/demos/3rdparty/volk/
  (a vendored volk copy inside the local RenderDoc build tree; timestamped 2026-05-25)

Version reconciliation with the installed Vulkan SDK:
  Vulkan SDK: 1.4.350.0  (C:/VulkanSDK/1.4.350.0), VK_HEADER_VERSION = 350.
  volk VOLK_HEADER_VERSION = 343 (< 350).
  volk includes the Vulkan headers itself. An OLDER volk against NEWER Vulkan
  headers is the safe/supported direction: volk 343 references a subset of the
  entrypoints the SDK-350 headers declare, so it compiles cleanly. It simply
  does not expose entrypoints added in header revisions 344..350 — none of which
  the MC2 Vulkan skeleton/probes use. (The reverse — newer volk vs older headers —
  is what breaks.)

Why this pair (not the SDK's volk.lib): the SDK ships only ARM64 volk*.lib and
no volk source; we need volk.c to compile it into the x64 Vulkan targets and,
crucially, to expose vmaImportVulkanFunctionsFromVolk (VMA compiles that helper
only when VOLK_HEADER_VERSION is visible, i.e. volk.h is included in the VMA TU).

Compiled ONLY under MC2_VULKAN (default OFF). Not part of the normal GL build.
